approval: Owner-approved pilot category and attribute scope; legal and compliance values are limited to current approved W2 policy.

compliance.publishGate: Fail closed when an applicable requirement in the currently approved W2 policy or verified evidence is missing; this dataset adds no legal, labeling, or certification rules.

retirementPolicy: Publish a new immutable dataset version; retain published category and schema snapshots. Retire categories through the existing guarded taxonomy lifecycle only after references and owner review are reconciled.
